bodyMd:
To target campaigns at a display level: first define a clear & consistent display-type naming convention (e.g. store-entrance-portrait-left; store-entrance-portrait-right). Then use display tags to refine targeting (e.g. overlooked by food hall, in high-traffic area, 24 hour passer-by traffic). Step-by-Step: Login to HQ Admin > Company Settings > Display Tags > add desired Display Tags > Displays & Devices > select Display(s) > assign Display Tags > Save Changes. Add Targeting Rules: open the Campaign > Audience Targeting tab > [+ Add New 'AND' Condition] > 'Store / Location Data' > Display Tag(s) > operator (e.g. 'includes selected') > add display tag(s) > Save Changes.
